resources.string: Android cannot currently verify this installation’s encrypted settings. Normal startup has been stopped. Monica has not cleared the settings or replaced the keys.
Restart the phone, unlock it with the system screen-lock credential, then retry.
If this began after restoring app data, flashing a ROM or modifying the system, check whether the original system and key environment can be restored. This error alone does not establish the cause.

Do not clear app data or uninstall Monica. Keep the original files. If you have a Monica-exported backup, verify it in another installation. A permanently lost system key cannot be recreated by retrying.
